data.body: **[P2] Track ambiguous invocations before allowing function reuse.** If Lambda accepts Invoke but its response is lost, this raises before registering the attempt in `self.invocations`. Per-case teardown cannot discover or stop that execution and skips settlement polling when the list is empty. Final run collection occurs after subsequent cases have reused the potentially occupied function. Register the marker before dispatch, recover its execution ARN during teardown, and block reuse until settlement is established. Cover the lost-response path with a teardown regression.
